A trainee Grim Reaper assigned to Station 29, Unit R. Easygoing and sociable, 0204 is far more interested in making friends and killing time in the lounge than fulfilling the traditional duties of a Reaper. He laughs easily and keeps things light, rarely lingering on expectations - especially his own.
